cleanup.description: function that clears/resets the state of its object; after it returns, the object's link metadata may be zeroed/cleared

destructor.description: function that destroys/frees an object; may call cleanup and link_detach

state_reset.description: operation that zeroes/resets the memory of its first argument, clearing fields including link storage

link_detach.description: operation that detaches/unlinks a link/peer entry from its container; must run before the container's link storage is cleared

link_storage.description: field inside the container that stores the link/peer metadata used by link_detach
